_note: The HTML sitemap, 2026-09-22, built with the footer cull. It is the backstop that lets the footer stop being one: every page on the site, one hop from every page, in a single link. The list is rendered by site_index() in build.py from the same `built` list that writes sitemap.xml and llms.txt, so it cannot go stale by hand. Indexed and linked from the footer's bottom bar. Nothing on it is a price, a status or a count.
